Grow Calc – Smart Grower’s Calculator Grow Calc is an all-in-one toolkit for growers, combining precise calculators and reference tools to optimize every aspect of plant cultivation. From light and canopy planning to climate, irrigation, nutrition, and water chemistry, Grow Calc provides instant insights based on proven horticultural formulas. Whether you are a hobby gardener, hydroponic enthusiast, or commercial grower, Grow Calc helps you plan, measure, and fine-tune your setup for healthier plants and higher yields. KEY FEATURES: Lighting Calculators • Convert PPFD ↔ DLI and plan photoperiods. • Estimate PPFD from lux using light source spectrum. • Calculate required PPFD to reach a target DLI. • Analyze fixture efficiency (µmol/J) and coverage per area. • Predict PPFD at different heights with distance adjustments. • Determine dimming percentage for your target intensity. • Evaluate uniformity ratios (min/avg, min/max) across your canopy. Canopy and Yield Planning • Plan planting density with row and spacing calculations. • Account for aisle losses to estimate effective growing area. • Calculate crown coverage, overlap percentage, and photons per plant. • Estimate DLI per plant and yield per square meter. • Forecast crop cycles per year and annual production. Climate Management • Calculate VPD (leaf and air) from temperature and humidity. • Get dew point, absolute humidity, and target RH for optimal VPD. • Estimate CO₂ injection rates and cylinder duration. • Plan dehumidification needs based on canopy area. Irrigation Tools • Perform dilution calculations (C1·V1 = C2·V2). • Calculate runoff percentage and cycle time per emitter. • Mix two water sources by EC to reach a target conductivity. • Plan daily irrigation schedule and net uptake. • Calculate system capacity and maximum plants supported by your pump. Nutrition Management • Convert EC to PPM with selectable TDS scales. • Calculate salt dosing based on target nutrient concentration. • Estimate acid requirements for pH adjustment. • Convert between mg/L and mmol/L. • Plan stock solutions and working concentrations. • Adjust and monitor N:P:K balance. Water Chemistry • Mix RO and tap water to reach target EC and alkalinity. • Calculate required dilution volumes for different water sources. • Convert alkalinity between mg/L CaCO₃ and dKH. Crop Presets • Access predefined target ranges for leafy greens, fruiting crops, cut flowers, potted plants, and ornamentals. • See recommended DLI, VPD, and CO₂ levels for each crop type. • Quick-check your own PPFD, hours, temperature, and humidity against preset ranges. Grow Calc brings together the essential calculations and reference values that growers use every day. Simple to use, accurate, and comprehensive — your reliable companion for modern cultivation.
